blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The current Ethereum StakedUSDeV2 implementation inherits active holder restrictions: BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE can addToBlacklist/removeFromBlacklist, FULL_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE blocks transfers and withdrawals, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can redistributeLockedAmount by burning and reminting a restricted holder's shares. At Ethereum@26224760 (2026-10-19T06:14:11+00:00), hasRole(keccak256("BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE"),0x3b0aaf6e6fcd4a7ceef8c92c32dfea9e64dc1862)=true; owner()=0xe8dc0fab349ea169283c48ccfd09d797e6db7c94 and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE,owner)=true. Additional currently active blacklist managers0x21f9236e8ee76474284fe8cde6ece6c8d19d781e and0x49e9f81a5ce0d492799c14049aef12df7bc955fe were also confirmed from grant logs and pinned membership reads. Materiality was measured rather than inferred from a missing chain breakdown: totalSupply974,615,217.656517 shares minus the pinned balance280,863,752.149420 held by official StakedUSDeOFTAdapter0x211cc4dd073734da055fbf44a2b4667d5e5fe5d2 leaves693,751,465.507097 canonical shares,71.144736% of the global975,126,902.791292 share estimate (API USD circulating value divided by redeem price1.2533558006916987). Plasma is also material: at block35449291, its StakedUSDeOFT0x211cc4dd073734da055fbf44a2b4667d5e5fe5d2 totalSupply185,695,471.068352 shares is19.043211%. The verified Plasma token checks blackList for both sender and recipient on every _update, and owner0xabd3645ba0bb60c238bede64378826e1206f5072 can directly updateBlackList and seize blacklisted balances with redistributeBlackListedFunds. blackLister()=0 does not remove this direct owner path. Both material implementations therefore independently support Yes. Parent USDe is classified Upstream on issuer/custodial backing, but parent status does not weaken these direct active controls. Other bridged supply is within the approximately9.81% remaining allocation; no unmeasured peripheral deployment is used to set this verdict.

oracleRisk.summary: Ethereum sUSDe's local share-to-USDe conversion is deterministic ERC-4626 accounting, not a redundant external feed. Verified StakedUSDe.totalAssets() returns the USDe balance minus linearly unvested rewards; inherited ERC4626 conversions use that value and totalSupply(). No external price oracle or autonomous feed failover enters this local calculation. Parent USDe's offchain RFQ pricing and hedging risks remain inherited separately; this review grants no parent pricing, bridge, cooldown, or executable-unwind relief.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: sUSDe's vault exchange rate values each share against the USDe held by the staking contract for minting and redemption, so the pro-rata share quote is a price-sensitive top-level authority. sUSDe creates no borrower-owned debt positions or collateral-liquidation markets, and therefore needs no branch rows.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: LayerZero metadata identifies Ethereum's sUSDe OFT adapter and 22 non-native OFT or OFT Adapter deployments. Pinned reads additionally confirm sUSDe deployments and LayerZero endpoints on Plasma and X Layer; their owners have changed since the July Safe observations. Monad's exact deployment is a verified StakedUSDeOFT whose constructor configures a LayerZero endpoint, delegate and rate limiter; its endpoint, peer set and limits were not read. TON's tsUSDe jetton remains mintable with a disclosed admin. Route identities are documented, while complete messaging controls, TON bridge internals and current runtime materiality remain unresolved.
